# The paths the Holodeck Officer (holo) may change on a holo/ branch, one prefix per line.
# The holo Action reads this file from main (never from the branch), and the holo probe keeps
# the same list (tests check they agree). Anything else on a holo branch fails the
# "Holodeck paths only" step and shows as OUT OF BOUNDS in the Review bay.
__version__.py
api/schema/
design-system/
fixtures/
frontend/dist/
frontend/package-lock.json
frontend/package.json
frontend/public/
frontend/src/
frontend/tools/
holodeck/
